# Data loading

```{r}

latent <- fread(latent.path, data.table = F, sep = ",", header = TRUE, index = FALSE)
```

# Datas <- concat(latents, labels) 

```{r}

c(names(latent), names(data_disc))

data <- cbind(latent, data_disc)
names(data) <- c(names(latent), names(data_disc))
data[, names(data_disc)] <- lapply(data[, names(data_disc)], as.factor)


head(data)

```


# Exclusion des relations continu → discret
# Entrainement BN - version with complete DAG

```{r}

disc <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.factor)]
cont <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.numeric)]


blacklist <- expand.grid(from = cont, to = disc)

bn <- hc(
  data,
  score = "bic-cg",
  blacklist = blacklist
)

bn_fitted_complete <- bn.fit(bn, data, method = "mle-cg") 

```





```{r}

scale <- c(100, 200, 500, 1000, 2000, 3000, 4000)
mu <- c()
sigma <- c()
for(s in scale){
  # print(paste(i*1000, logLik(bn.fitted, data[1:(i*1000),]))) 
  log.lik <- c()
  set.seed(42)
  for(j in 1:1000){
    index <- sapply(runif(s, 1, 10000), as.integer)
    
    log.lik <- c(log.lik, logLik(bn.fitted, data[index, ]))  
  }
  mu <- c(mu, mean(log.lik))
  sigma <- c(sigma, sd(log.lik))
}



logLik(bn.fitted, data[1:10000, ])
print(logLik(bn.fitted, data[1:10000, ]))

data[1:10000, ]
mu
sigma

for(i in 1:length(mu)){
  print(sigma[i]/mu[i])
}


```



# Bootstrap on datas to identify robust arcs

```{r}

m.list <- 1:20
duree <- c()
for(m in m.list){
  start.time <- Sys.time()

  R <- 10
  set.seed(42)
  
  arcs.list.boot <- bn.boot(
    data = data, 
    R = R, 
    m = m *100, # nrow(data) 
    algorithm = "hc",  
    algorithm.args = list(score = "bic-cg", blacklist = blacklist), 
    statistic = arcs)
  
  
  end.time <- Sys.time()
  duree <- c(duree, end.time -start.time)
}

```


```{r}


plot(m.list, duree)
lines(m.list, sqrt(duree), type = "o")
lines(m.list, m.list/8 +0.4, type = "o", col = "red")
lines(m.list, (m.list/8 +0.4)**2, type = "o", col = "blue")

new.m.list<- 1:10000
estim.duree <- (new.m.list /800 +0.4)**2
plot(new.m.list /100, estim.duree, col = "green")


```







# Bootstrap  to identify robust arcs

```{r}

start.time <- Sys.time()

set.seed(42)

arcs.list.boot <- bn.boot(
  data = data, 
  R = 1000, 
  m = 4000, 
  algorithm = "hc", 
  algorithm.args = list(score = "bic-cg", blacklist = blacklist), 
  statistic = arcs)


end.time <- Sys.time()
end.time -start.time

library(dplyr)
library(plyr)

arcs.bn.boot <- do.call(rbind, arcs.list.boot)
arcs.bn.boot <- as.data.frame(arcs.bn.boot)

arcs.bn.boot <- arcs.bn.boot %>% group_by_all() %>% count
arcs.bn.boot$freq <- arcs.bn.boot$freq/1000

DAG.path <- "datas/arcs_bn_boot-R_1000-m_2000.csv"
write.csv(arcs.bn.boot, DAG.path)

```


```{r}

DAG.path <- "datas/arcs_bn_boot-R_1000-m_2000.csv"
arcs.bn.boot <- read.csv(DAG.path)[, 2:4]
arcs.bn.boot

```
